title: MT61321: Numerical Fluid Flow
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Mathematical formulation of problem based on heat, mass and momentum balance:
setting up governing equation, boundary conditions. Case studies : examplesmelting behavior of additions in steel melts, homogenization of liquid steel
by gas purging, fluid flow, heat transfer and solidification characteristics
during welding, continuous casting of steel etc.Numerical Technique and
computer applications : Solution of partial differential equations by Control
Volume Technique: Discretization of differential equations, solution
algorithm, Staggered grids, Gauss Seidel, TDMA solver. Physical Simulation
â an empirical way to characterize fluid flow, heat and mass transfer:
Laboratory experimental design through similarity criteria, Dimensional
analysis, Case studies.
